area: Traffic analysis: SSL coverage's true inspection coverage (ssl_true_coverage.py over ssl_coverage.py, traffic_logs.py and the sample tenant)
title: One true inspection figure: four parts adding up to 100% per unit, unknown never counted as inspected, each encrypted share tied to its cause, estimate always labelled

checks.what: Plain HTTP, HTTPS decrypted, HTTPS not inspected and unknown add up to exactly 100.0% in each unit (largest-remainder tenths), for thirds, a tiny slice beside a huge one and one slice alone; zero, negative, non-finite, boolean or text amounts give no split

Unknown (unmapped Insights protocols, NSS lines without the decrypted field) is never counted as inspected: the figure is a floor with a stated range, and the summary, headline and history use the same figure
Bytes and transactions are split apart, each its own 100%; logs without sizes give no bytes split and say so

NSS web lines left encrypted are tied to the first SSL rule in order naming their category or application, then a catch-all, then Zscaler's pinned exemptions, else 'not explained'; shares add up to the not-inspected part; Insights app bytes count once, are capped to the part, and the rest is 'not split' with the likely rules
The policy estimate is labelled 'Estimate, not measured', names the licence and permission for the measured figure, and never sets a measured share in the summary or headline
Client Connector, forwarding and PAC bypasses and ZPA private apps are listed apart with fixes and change no percentage
The web logs reference is a 400 before any sign-in when malformed, of another kind, gone, not the caller's, or without ZIA web lines

The page builds the section with DOM calls only (tenant names via textContent), checks every fix link is the app's own page, and gives each part a word and a table, not colour alone; new controls have help in both catalogues
checks.standard: ASVS V5.3.3 · CWE-79 · WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 · SC 3.3.2

findings.title: Before: the SSL coverage headline's inspected share left unclassified traffic out of the denominator, so unknown traffic was in effect counted at the inspected rate
findings.fix: the summary, headline and history use the true figure, with unknown in the denominator and shown as a range

findings.title: During development: the run's own log list shadowed the web logs parameter in ssl_coverage.run, so a run with logs failed

notes: Verified against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 (as ssl_coverage.py already is): zins web_traffic.get_protocols with traffic_unit TRANSACTIONS and BYTES, shadow_it.get_apps.

Assumed (marked in the code): the typical traffic mix of the policy estimate (ASSUMED_MIX, about 5% plain HTTP); that ZPA application segments' traffic never reaches ZIA's SSL inspection; the NSS ssldecrypted, reqsize and respsize fields as traffic_logs.py already reads them.
